nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) storing token balances; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) holding spend allowances; written by _approve.
Private uint256 total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Private string token name set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private string token symbol set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private string generator version set in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Public ERC20 transfer; reads msg.sender as sender and forwards to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; checks allowance of msg.sender, moves funds and lowers allowance.
Public ERC20 approve; lets msg.sender set an allowance for spender via _approve.
Public helper that adds addedValue to the caller's allowance using an unchecked-free addition.
Public helper that subtracts subtractedValue from the caller's allowance after a require check.
Internal transfer routine; validates addresses/balance, performs unchecked balance subtraction and updates recipient balance.
Internal mint routine; increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance and emits Transfer from address(0).
Internal burn routine; decreases the account balance and _totalSupply after a balance check.
Internal allowance writer; validates owner/spender and stores the allowance in _allowances.
Payable constructor of ServicePayer that forwards msg.value to an arbitrary receiver via IPayable.pay.
Payable constructor of the deployed token; initializes ERC20 metadata, ServicePayer and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender(); used for transfers, allowances and the initial mint.
External payable call to an attacker-controllable address (feeReceiver_) performed inside the ServicePayer constructor.
Unchecked subtraction of the transferred amount from the sender balance inside _transfer.
Allowance addition inside increaseAllowance; subject to arithmetic overflow behaviour (reverts in 0.8).
Destination address passed to transfer.
Amount of tokens passed to transfer.
Source address whose tokens are moved by transferFrom.
Destination address passed to transferFrom.
Amount of tokens passed to transferFrom.
Address granted an allowance by approve.
Allowance value set by approve.
Address whose allowance is increased.
Value added to the caller's allowance.
Address whose allowance is decreased.
Value subtracted from the caller's allowance.
Token name passed to the deployed constructor.
Token symbol passed to the deployed constructor.
Payable receiver address forwarded to the ServicePayer constructor.
Payable address that receives msg.value through IPayable.pay.
String service tag forwarded to the external pay call.
Local copy of the caller's allowance read in transferFrom.
Local copy of the sender balance read in _transfer.
Local copy of the account balance read in _burn.
Local copy of the caller's allowance read in decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] and spends the caller's allowance.
approve sets the allowance of _msgSender().
increaseAllowance reads and rewrites the allowance of _msgSender().
decreaseAllowance reads and rewrites the allowance of _msgSender().
HelloERC20 constructor mints 10000e18 to _msgSender().
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom.
spender parameter flows into approve.
amount parameter flows into approve.
spender parameter flows into increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter flows into the allowance addition.
spender parameter flows into decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter flows into the allowance subtraction.
name_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded to the ServicePayer constructor.
receiver parameter is the target of the external pay call.
serviceName parameter is passed into the external pay call.
currentAllowance local is assigned from _allowances in transferFrom.
currentAllowance local is assigned from _allowances in decreaseAllowance.
senderBalance local is read from _balances in _transfer.
accountBalance local is read from _balances in _burn.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads and updates _balances for sender and recipient.
_mint increases _balances[account].
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _balances[account].
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
Unchecked balance subtraction writes back the low-level arithmetic result into _balances.
Allowance addition result is written into _allowances.
transfer internally invokes _transfer.
transferFrom internally invokes _transfer.
transferFrom lowers the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance sets the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance sets the new allowance through _approve.
HelloERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer constructor.
HelloERC20 constructor mints the initial supply via _mint.
ServicePayer constructor performs the external pay call.
_transfer executes the unchecked balance subtraction block.
increaseAllowance executes the allowance addition expression.
The external call to a user-supplied receiver can re-enter the contract's public entry points such as transfer before the constructor call completes.
